description: Export project data as a JSON Schema string.

configTypeId.description: Export profile id used for the JSON Schema export.

inheritanceHandler.description: How Inheritance relations are emitted: None ignores them, IncludeInProperties flattens inherited elements into the child's properties, IncludeAsRef emits the parent under $defs and references it.

inheritenceHandler.description: Deprecated misspelling of 'inheritanceHandler', kept for existing callers. Use 'inheritanceHandler'; passing both with different values is an error.

rootNodeId.description: Root node id (a Type). Optional only when the project has one Type or one node carries the Root Id mixin; with several Types it is required, and a call without it is refused with the list of Types.

name: export_jsonschema
title: Export JSON Schema
